narrative.overview: The implemented identity is editorial and grounded: large serif statements, compact sans-serif details, generous space, and ruled rows. Deep green establishes the company presence; pale surfaces organize supporting content. Code-led implementation; no separate visual comp.
keyCharacteristics: Paired columns that stack on narrow screens
Restrained lime emphasis and directional arrows

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: Use lime focus outlines on green surfaces and the dedicated focus color on light backgrounds.

dos: Do preserve visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use typography, spacing, and rules as visual structure.
donts: Don't invent listings, availability, or contact forms for the portfolio.
